title: IOS Acquisition Engine — One Property ID, Multichannel Outreach, Response Suppression

sections.label: 1 · YOU UPLOAD THE LIST → ONE PROPERTY ID
sections.note: Everything starts with one upload. Before any record is created, the system checks whether it has seen this property before, then gives it a permanent ID and creates exactly one record in Close. Re-uploading the same list updates that record — it never creates a second one.

sections.label: 2 · FIND THE OWNERS AND THEIR CONTACT POINTS
sections.note: BatchData returns however many owners, phone numbers and email addresses exist. Each one becomes a numbered child of the property — P01, P02, E01 — so every phone and email stays tied to the parent. DNC numbers and previous opt-outs are removed here, before anything is sent.

sections.label: 3 · REACH OUT ON THREE CHANNELS AT ONCE
sections.note: One router splits the contact points by type and hands them to the right platform. The Property ID travels with every record, written into each platform's own ID field. That is what lets you swap a vendor later by rewriting one branch instead of the system.

sections.label: 4 · SOMEONE REPLIES — FIND THEIR PROPERTY
sections.note: All three platforms report replies into a single webhook. The system reads the child ID in the reply, looks up which property it belongs to, and updates that one master record with who replied and which channel they replied on.

sections.label: 5 · STOP EVERYTHING ELSE, THEN TELL YOU
sections.note: Outreach is shut off across all three platforms in parallel, so nothing else goes out to a property whose owner is already talking to you. Only once that is done do you get pinged to take over the seller conversation.
